note: A truncated frame, which is what a dropped connection mid-write actually looks like.
Valid JSON of the wrong shape. `null` is valid JSON, which is why the sentinel exists.
An array where an event belongs, from a client that batched without being asked to.
A kind nobody defined. The union must refuse it rather than fall through to a default.
A known kind with its payload missing, which is the shape of a client-side bug.
A sequence sent as a string. JavaScript would happily compare it; the schema must not.
An undeclared field. Before X-05 this was dropped silently, which is a field nobody validated.
A prompt injection inside a legitimate frame: accepted as a frame, still only ever text.
